items.prompt: A line contains a duplicate tag and also a wrong checksum. Which result takes precedence?

options.text: BAD_CHECKSUM, because checksum is always inspected first.
options.why: The parser validates all field grammar before checksum calculation.

options.text: OK, if the duplicate values agree.
options.why: Equal values do not make a duplicate text tag valid.
A grammar violation cannot be rescued or reclassified by checksum arithmetic.

options.text: A partial OK result for fields before the duplicate.
options.why: The function emits one classified result for the entire message.

items.explanation: A grammar violation cannot be rescued or reclassified by checksum arithmetic.
